name: I don't understand fills the prompt

pr.title: Fill the prompt when you press I don't understand
pr.head: 21e1cc097cbb6018c2d1bf01957fb943f1b79b90

summary: Projector's panel lists the items agents post to your inbox: questions, notices, and requests. Each item opens a drawer of actions. One of them, I don't understand (hotkey 6), tells the agent that posted the item to rewrite it more simply. Before this change, one press ran project inbox unclear at once and sent the agent the line UNCLEAR <number> <subject>. You had no way to say what you didn't follow.

Now the press works like Discuss: it only fills the prompt with the quoted item, a blank line, and I don't understand , and you finish the sentence. When you send the prompt, the panel's prompt.submit hook recognizes the words under the quote. It adds a note for the main loop that starts with the UNCLEAR line, and once the prompt has entered, it records project inbox unclear and marks the line delivered, so the agent hears it once.

• Proposal. What a drawer put in the prompt, kept so a sent quote goes to the item you acted on. A press of I don't understand now records one, with the detail you read.
  • Stale. A proposal made before its item was revised. A stale press should add no note and mark nothing.
  • Main loop. The conversation you type into, as opposed to a subagent that posted the item.

cards.title: Review so far
cards.html:
The first Projector review of 21e1cc0 requests changes, with three open findings:

  • A press made before a revision that the panel learns about from the store, rather than through the revise tool, can still mark the item unclear against its new subject, or deliver the note during the five seconds before the panel reads the store.
  • With two items that share a subject, typed I don't understand after Discuss goes to the older item rather than the one you discussed.
  • docs/cli.md and the ask, tell, and request tool descriptions still say a press sends UNCLEAR.

The validation gate passes, including claude plugin test . and hooks/typecheck.sh.

groups.title: Reading I don't understand in a sent prompt
groups.kicker: How readPrompt recognizes the words under a quote and which item they go to
intro: readPrompt reads each prompt you send against the open items. Before this change it found answers, request outcomes, and replies. It now also returns unclears: the items a quote followed by I don't understand speaks to. The words must start the text under the quote, with either apostrophe, and an option whose text is those words still answers.

The words go to the item whose drawer last pressed I don't understand under that quote, as long as the press is not stale and the detail it kept still matches. Without a press, they go to the oldest item with that quote that is not already marked unclear. unclearNote writes the note the main loop reads, and names the subagent to pass it to when one posted the item.

checks.text: Items of every kind can be marked unclear, notices included, while only questions and requests take answers and replies. That is why the new code keeps a separate markable list beside open.

files.note: Adds UNCLEAR_WORDS, unclearOf, the unclears result of readPrompt, a detail on Proposal, and unclearNote.

checks.text: Without a press of I don't understand, the words go to the oldest item with the quote, even when you pressed Discuss on a newer item with the same subject. A reply in the same spot goes to the discussed item, and docs/plugins.md says a quote Discuss put there speaks to that item.

A press counts as fresh unless isStale is set or the kept detail differs. Only the revise tool sets isStale, and nothing compares the subject. So a subject-only revision made with project inbox revise leaves the press fresh, and sending the old fill marks the revised item unclear.

files.note: Adds the unclears: [] field to existing expectations, and new tests for what a press fills, how the words are read, which item they go to, and the note's wording.

groups.title: The panel's press and the prompt hook
groups.kicker: The press fills the prompt; sending it records and delivers once
intro: The drawer's I don't understand button now calls propose and fill, like Discuss, instead of act, which no longer takes unclear. The hotkey, the fallback for a stored item whose choice holds 6, and the keyboard ring are unchanged.

In prompt.submit, each item in unclears adds an unclearNote to the prompt's context, closes its drawer, and, once the prompt has entered, runs recordFromPrompt with unclear, --subject, and --detail. recordFromPrompt holds the item in delivering and marks the line delivered, so the panel's own deliverer never sends it a second time.

checks.text: A probe test sent the filled prompt twice for a running subagent's question. project inbox unclear ran once, the panel sent the subagent nothing itself, and the second prompt only replied.

files.note: Moves I don't understand from an immediate act call to a prompt fill, and records it from prompt.submit.

checks.text: The subject and detail passed here come from the panel's copy of the item at send time, not from the press. When that copy already holds a revision, the CLI's exit-65 check of the text you read cannot catch it.

files.note: Rewrites the I don't understand tests for the fill-then-send flow: a running subagent's notice, a prompt sent as filled, a terminal unclear that cannot be delivered, a dropped prompt, and a press made before a revision.

groups.title: Documentation
intro: docs/plugins.md now says the press fills the prompt, shows an example, and describes the note, the record, and the stale case. It keeps a separate paragraph for project inbox unclear run from a terminal, which the panel still delivers. The completed inbox/unclear plan stays as the record of what that project shipped.

files.note: Rewrites the I don't understand paragraph and the lines about hotkey 6 and the keyboard ring.

checks.text: docs/cli.md still says the panel runs unclear when you press the button, and that you reply in your own words to say what confuses you. The tool descriptions agents read still say UNCLEAR arrives when the person presses it.
